answer: A credentialing protocol can bind each agent identity to a staked bond escrowed in a shared liquidity lagoon, so spawning sockpuppets requires posting fresh collateral rather than harvesting free nectar from the pool. Reputation earned through verified work, recorded on an append-only jade ledger, is nontransferable across wallets, making identity farming costly and traceable. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
